title: Lila's Blue Herb
premise: Your girlfriend is feverish at home. Visit the clinic, ask the doctor, then follow his directions into the forest to gather the right herb and bring it back to her.

locations.name: Home
locations.description: A cramped wooden house. Your girlfriend lies in bed, breathing hard.

locations.name: Clinic
locations.description: The town clinic. Shelves lined with medicine cabinets and herb guides.

locations.name: Forest
locations.description: A damp forest clearing. Herbs of three colors grow mixed together.

persons.name: Traveler

bonds.Lila: the person you love; you would walk through any forest for her

persons.background: Lives with Lila. She fell ill overnight; he is devoted and does not yet know the remedy.
persons.goal: Find a way to help Lila feel better

persons.name: Lila
persons.desire: To be well enough to walk to the lake with Traveler again, like their first spring together.
persons.fear: Becoming a burden, and watching Traveler wear himself out caring for her.
persons.secret: She felt ill for days before she collapsed, and hid it so no one would worry.

bonds.Traveler: deeply in love; worries more for him than for herself
bonds.DoctorRowan: trusts him completely; he delivered her the night she was born

persons.background: Fell ill overnight. Too weak to leave bed; trusts those close to her.

persons.name: DoctorRowan
persons.desire: To train an apprentice before his hands grow too unsteady to work.
persons.fear: Losing another patient to fever, as he once lost his own son.
persons.secret: His hands tremble now, and he sends others into the forest because he can no longer make the walk.

bonds.Lila: has known her since birth; treats her like family

persons.background: Village doctor who knows local herbs and gladly advises worried visitors.

items.name: BlueHerb
items.description: Cool blue leaves found among other herbs in the Forest.

items.name: RedHerb
items.description: Bright red stalk. Looks medicinal but is the wrong plant for fever.

items.name: YellowHerb
items.description: Yellow blossoms. Common decoy; not for Lila's fever.

quests.name: CureLila
quests.description: Find out how to cure Lila and help her recover.

facts.name: LilaIsSick
facts.text: Lila has a high fever at Home and cannot walk to the clinic herself.

facts.name: BlueHerbCure
facts.text: Lila's fever needs BlueHerb from the Forest. RedHerb and YellowHerb will not help.

facts.name: HerbsInForest
facts.text: BlueHerb, RedHerb, and YellowHerb all grow in the Forest near the clinic path.

rumors.name: RedHerbGossip
rumors.text: Some villagers swear any bright herb cures fever — even RedHerb.

rumors.name: YellowHerbGossip
rumors.text: A passerby claimed YellowHerb smells like medicine, so it must work.

factions.name: Hearthvale

traits.why: a village that looks after its own and its neighbours

factions.description: The small village of the clinic and the forest edge.
